mode: One shared Hyprland/Quickshell compositor; phone and external outputs
captureMethod: Binary-safe adb exec-out screencap -p -d on each discovered SurfaceFlinger output, sequentially within the same running session
scene: Mobile clock/calendar widgets; Foot runs actual uname, os-release, pacman and hyprctl commands; Neovim opens an unmodified read-only copy of CompositorEndpoint.java
sceneChanges: Opened two owned desktop windows and copied public source/demo script into a temporary Linux directory; hid Squeekboard using its real touch control
pixelEdits: None. Whole raw PNGs embedded verbatim in HTML, proportionally scaled with borders and editorial text outside the screenshots
limits: These are emulator captures, not ARM64 device evidence. Screenshots do not prove audibility, hardware acceleration, battery life, Wallet/work-profile compatibility, or complete plugin coverage. Unknown Android status icons remain as captured; they were not retouched.
